# scribemd

> Permissionless markdown workspaces with per-workspace git history. Anyone
> with a workspace URL can read, write, rename, delete, and commit `.md`
> files via a tiny JSON API. The URL is the only credential — treat it like
> a password.

If you are an AI agent and a user has shared a scribemd workspace URL with
you (looks like `https://<host>/w/<uuid>`), use the API below. Do not invent
or guess workspace IDs.

## Workspace URL shape

```
https://<host>/w/<uuid>                              # human UI
https://<host>/api/workspaces/<uuid>/...             # JSON API
```

Extract `<host>` and `<uuid>` from the URL the user gave you.

## File API

Errors come back as `{"error": string}` with HTTP 4xx/5xx.

### List files

```
GET /api/workspaces/{uuid}/files
→ { "files": ["note1.md", "ideas/today.md", ...] }
```

### Read a file (current)

```
GET /api/workspaces/{uuid}/files/{path}
→ { "path": "note.md", "content": "# ..." }
```

### Read a file at a past commit

```
GET /api/workspaces/{uuid}/files/{path}?at={sha}
→ { "path": "note.md", "content": "# ...", "at": "<sha>" }
```

### Create or overwrite

```
PUT /api/workspaces/{uuid}/files/{path}
{ "content": "# Markdown body" }
→ { "ok": true }
```

Parent directories are created automatically. Use this for both new files
and edits — there is no separate "create" call.

### Rename / move

```
POST /api/workspaces/{uuid}/rename
{ "from": "old/path.md", "to": "new/path.md" }
→ { "ok": true, "from": "old/path.md", "to": "new/path.md" }
```

Fails if the destination already exists.

### Delete

```
DELETE /api/workspaces/{uuid}/files/{path}
→ { "ok": true }
```

## Git API

Each workspace is its own git repo. Edits sit "uncommitted" until you call
commit. History is preserved across commits.

### Uncommitted change count

```
GET /api/workspaces/{uuid}/status
→ { "changed": 3 }
```

### Commit current changes

```
POST /api/workspaces/{uuid}/commit
{ "message": "Refactor outline" }
→ { "sha": "abc123..." }            # success
→ { "sha": null, "reason": "nothing to commit" }
```

Commit message defaults to "Update" if omitted.

### List commits

```
GET /api/workspaces/{uuid}/history
→ { "commits": [
    { "sha": "...", "short": "abc1234", "message": "...", "date": "ISO-8601" },
    ...
] }
```

Newest first. Capped at 200.

### Commit details

```
GET /api/workspaces/{uuid}/history/{sha}
→ { "sha": "...", "message": "...", "date": "...", "files": ["note.md", ...] }
```

## Workspace API

### Create a new workspace

```
POST /api/workspaces
→ { "id": "<uuid>" }
```

Only do this if the user explicitly asks for a new workspace. If they have
shared an existing URL, work in that workspace.

## Rules

- Only `.md` files are accepted. Other extensions return 400.
- Paths are confined to the workspace; `..` traversal is rejected.
- Last writer wins — no locking. When editing, prefer read → modify → write
  rather than blind overwrites.
- This service has no auth, no audit log, and (besides git history) no
  versioning. Be conservative with deletes; ask the user first.

## Example session

```bash
HOST="https://scribemd.example.com"
ID="b432e3b0-e8bf-403d-a808-b7517cf97cf4"

# See what's there
curl -s "$HOST/api/workspaces/$ID/files"

# Read, edit, save
curl -s "$HOST/api/workspaces/$ID/files/welcome.md"
curl -s -X PUT "$HOST/api/workspaces/$ID/files/notes/today.md" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"content":"# Today\n\n- ..."}'

# Commit
curl -s -X POST "$HOST/api/workspaces/$ID/commit" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"message":"Daily note"}'

# Browse history
curl -s "$HOST/api/workspaces/$ID/history"
```
